title: UI风格#99 - Tokyo Underground (东京地下铁)
description: 创建第99种UI风格：东京地下铁风格 - 霓虹闪烁、简约指引、深夜车站。输出到 G:/claude_code_project/web/index_planCU.html

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Tokyo Underground style When color palette Then features metro blue, neon pink, platform gray, warning yellow
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 需要设计：#00BFFF (地铁蓝), #FF1493 (霓虹粉), #4A4A4A (站台灰), #FFD700 (警示黄), #1A1A2E (深夜黑)

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Tokyo Underground style When typography Then uses japanese transit: Yu Gothic UI, Noto Sans JP, or Helvetica
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 字体选择：Yu Gothic UI (标题), Noto Sans JP (正文), Helvetica (数字)

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Tokyo Underground style When layout Then station maps, platform lines, transit signage, route diagrams
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 布局特点：线路图、站台指示、导视系统、换乘标识

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Tokyo Underground style When UI elements Then neon glow, platform textures, transit animations
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 交互特点：霓虹发光、站台质感、列车动画、报站音效

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Tokyo Underground UI When functional Then includes transit chat, station agents, line stats
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 功能需求：交通聊天、车站代理、线路统计

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Tokyo Underground UI When copy Then uses transit language: 'Platform', 'Transfer', 'Express', 'Destination'
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 创意文案：标题'PLATFORM. TRANSFER. EXPRESS.'、按钮'SEND'→'BOARD'、'SUBMIT'→'DEPART'
